long_biography.plain_text:
Palmali's operating model combined ship agency, chartering, technical management and direct fleet investment under Mübariz Mansimov Gurbanoğlu. That mix allowed the group to serve petroleum, dry-bulk and container cargoes while working across inland and open-sea routes. Mansimov remained closely identified with the company's maritime strategy as it broadened beyond its first Istanbul office.

Before Palmali, he trained at a military school in Baku, left the Soviet army and took work aboard merchant ships. He entered commercial shipping with partners by acquiring small vessels, then developed Agent 34 into Palmali. The company's early move from agency services towards fleet ownership placed him in both the commercial and operational sides of maritime transport.
